Name: Rainbow Crystal Path
Author: Reneeeeeeee
Description: I was looking for a recolour of the Crystal Path when I found Kirtini's Filled In Crystal Path and loved it! This is a bright rainbow recolour of that path. Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI. Recolours are welcome but please remember to credit Kirtini for their original Filled In Crystal Path.
